author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆಯಮಲಿರಲು ಜನದೂರ ಸರಿಯುವರು
ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠತೆಯೊಲಿಯುವುದು ಮಾದರಿಯ ನಡೆಗೆ
ಓಷ್ಠದಿಂದುದುರಿರೆ ಜೀವಿಯರಳಿಸೊ ಮಾತು
ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠನೆ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When the intoxication of superiority sets in, people move away;
seniority comes to one whose conduct is exemplary;
when words fall from the lips that make a life blossom,
the elder is the great one, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Arrogance drives people away. Real seniority is earned by exemplary conduct and by words that help others flourish. Such an elder is truly great.
